# Promobeez

> Promobeez is a barter marketplace that connects local businesses with nano and micro creators. Businesses post an offer such as a meal or a service, creators with local audiences apply, and the business pays only to unlock a creator's contact details. Promobeez takes no commission on the barter itself.

Primary market: Helsinki / Finland. App signup: https://my.promobeez.com
